rejectionReason: Reject as a duplicate of Eclipse JDT's lambda-to-method-reference cleanup. The original WatchExpression lambda invokes setResult without an explicit receiver, while the proposed pattern requires this. The generic rewrite also lacks binding checks: s -> this.staticMethod(s) is legal Java, but this::staticMethod cannot refer to that static method.
